1.explanation:
• src/core/handlers/embed.ts implements the ‘embed’ block handler in the core pipeline. It’s responsible for reading and inserting file content into the AST, but it never actually populates the wrapper when the output format is revealjs.  
• src/format/reveal/format-reveal.ts contains the revealjs‐specific logic and Pandoc arguments. Its configuration of section divs or filters may unintentionally suppress the embedded code nodes.  
• resources/filters/quarto-post/reveal.lua is the Lua post‐filter that applies revealjs‐specific transformations. It may drop or reshape the ‘cell’ divs produced by embed.ts.  
• resources/capabilities/knitr.R defines the R‐side knitr embed engine; it injects file content for HTML output. That script does not detect or handle revealjs slides correctly, so the code never makes it into the final revealjs HTML.
1.bug_scenario: When rendering a Quarto document to revealjs with the knitr “embed” engine, the external R script never gets injected. The slide HTML shows a <div class=“cell” data-file=“code.R”> wrapper but it’s empty — no code appears on the slide. By contrast, rendering the same embed block to plain HTML works correctly (the contents of code.R are inserted into a code block).

2.explanation:
• src/core/handlers/embed.ts: This TypeScript handler drives the generic ‘embed’ shortcode; it filters embed chunks based on output format and currently treats only plain HTML outputs, so it skips for revealjs.  
• resources/capabilities/knitr.R: The R capability script installs the knitr hooks for embed; it checks the output format class (HTML) and likewise omits content when the format is revealjs.  
• src/format/reveal/format-reveal.ts: The revealjs format registration does not re-enable or pass through the embed handler—no special override or support is wired in, so the generic embed logic never runs under revealjs. Fixing this requires updating the embed handler (and/or the knitr.R hooks) to recognize revealjs as an HTML‐like format or adjusting the revealjs formatter to explicitly include the embed filter.
2.bug_scenario: When rendering a Quarto document with format: revealjs and engine: knitr, the `{embed, file="code.R"}` chunk produces an empty <div class="cell" data-file="code.R"> with no code inside. In contrast, exactly the same embed chunk in a plain HTML output correctly inlines the contents of code.R. The bug indicates that the knitr embed engine is not emitting code for the revealjs format.
